body:
## What it does

Watches the original and the copies, follows their revenue, and reports daily on whether the trend is actually growing or just loud. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked. Following the revenue rather than the mentions is the difference between tracking a business and tracking a news cycle.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @dragosroua shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
